instruction: Help me configure the FastAPI web framework for building APIs. Clone the repository from 'https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi' to /home/user and set up the development environment following their setup instructions.

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing FastAPI framework setup. Evaluator verifies that the fastapi module can be imported without errors. The check_include_exclude metric ensures no error strings appear in output.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only verifies FastAPI installation/import capability, but does not verify repository cloning requirement
Instruction explicitly requires 'Clone the repository from https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi to /home/user' which is completely unchecked
Incomplete coverage: instruction has 2 distinct requirements (clone repo + setup environment), but evaluator only checks 1 (setup/import)
An agent could pass evaluation by simply running 'pip install fastapi' without ever cloning the repository, violating the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter to verify /home/user/fastapi directory exists using get_vm_command_line with command like ['test', '-d', '/home/user/fastapi', '&&', 'echo', 'exists']
Implement multi-part evaluator with partial scoring: 0.5 for repository exists at correct location, 0.5 for FastAPI imports correctly
Alternative approach: Check for both .git directory in /home/user/fastapi AND successful FastAPI import
Consider simplifying instruction to remove specific clone location if only import verification is intended
